==Biography==
===2016 Season===
In 2016 he was part of the lineup that is often referred as the "Exodia" of CBLOL: [[Yang (Felipe Zhao)|Yang]], [[Revolta]], [[tockers]], [[micaO]] and [[Jockster]], led by [[Peter Dun]] and [[Abaxial]]. The team managed to never lose a series that they played on Brazilian soil. They played at [[CBLOL 2016 Split 1]] and consequently won [[CBLOL 2016 Split 1 Playoffs]] after beating [[Keyd Stars]] for 3x0 in the Grand Finals. With the win, they classified [[INTZ]] to the [[2016 International Wildcard Invitational]], where they managed to achieve 3rd place among other Wildcards regions.
In the [[CBLOL 2016 Split 2|second split]], they found theyselves in a rivalry against [[CNB e-Sports Club]] until they beated them by 3-1 in the [[CBLOL 2016 Split 2 Playoffs|finals]]. In the [[IWCQ 2016]], they managed to classify to [[Worlds 2016]], where they made history by being the only Brazilian team to defeat an Asian team from a Major league by defeating [[EDward Gaming]], despite not qualifying for the main stage of the tournament.<ref>[https://www.espn.com.br/esports/artigo/_/id/5732003/adeus-exodia-o-fim-e-o-legado-do-quinteto-mais-vitorioso-do-cblol Adeus, Exodia: o fim e o legado do quinteto mais vitorioso do CBLoL]''espn.com.br''</ref>

== Trivia ==
* Highest Elo on Pre-Season 3 in the BR server.
* His favorite champion is {{ci|Aphelios}}.<ref>[https://twitter.com/libertyesports/status/1775916309076754675 Liberty Esports' Tweet] ''twitter.com''</ref>
* His favorite food is barbecue.
* His main hobbies are karaoke and playing acoustic guitar.
* His greatest inspiration in League is [[Deft]].
* Known for his {{ci|Ezreal}} and his {{ci|Varus}}.
* Portrayed as {{ci|Kalista}} in the CBLoL 2015 official wallpaper.
* Suffers from poliosis, which causes the loss of melanin in certain parts of his hair, as seen on his right eyebrow.<ref>[https://twitter.com/micaOlol/status/673851080720195584 MicaO's Tweet] ''twitter.com''</ref>
* There's a running gag in Brazil about how [[micaO]] used to be frequently out of position during teamfights. He talked about this in a interview and said that this gag pisses him off.<ref>[https://maisesports.com.br/lol-me-irrita-diz-micao-sobre-meme-fora-de-posicao/ LoL: “Me irrita”, diz micaO sobre meme “fora de posição” (Portuguese)] ''maisesports.com.br''</ref>
* Was the last member of the "Exodia" to retire.<ref>[https://x.com/luisshowtana/status/1860331220267135323 Showtana's X Post] ''x.com''</ref>
** Despite retiring in late 2024, his last competitive game was in [[CD 2025 Split 1]] playing for [[Dopamina E-Sport]].
** Is often referred as an "active retiree" for his competitiveness playing in tier 2 qualifiers despite being considered a retired player.
* Is a recurring guest in [[Ilha das Lendas]] LTA and CD co-streams.
=== Statistics ===
* Was the 1st player to reach 1000 kills in CBLoL.
** His 1000th kill was on [[Redemption eSports Porto Alegre|Redemption eSports]]' support [[Jockster]] (who ironically played support for MicaO during most of his career) in [[CBLOL 2019 Split 2]].
* Reached 1500 kills in the CBLOL on June 15th, 2024.
** The 2nd player to reach 1500 kills in the CBLOL, only after [[Tinowns]].
* Ended his career as a player with exactly 1900 kills in tier 1 competitions.
